title: Profile pictures
what: The profile pictures a provider that declares avatars keeps of rooms and people: each picture's subject and taken time, the picture bytes, and the query that pages the list (provider/src/avatar.rs, client/src/avatar.rs).

title: Wire bytes
what: How bytes cross a JSON body: base64 with the standard alphabet and padding, written and read by the serde helpers both libraries share (provider/src/bytes.rs, client/src/bytes.rs).

title: Send verbs and capabilities
what: The twelve send verbs and the sixteen capabilities a provider declares, the full set taken from the type itself so no reader keeps a list of its own (provider/src/capability.rs, client/src/capability.rs).

title: Provider declaration
what: What a provider declares of itself in one body: its key and label, modes, capabilities, dialect, what its rooms show, numbering and whether it takes a speaker (provider/src/declaration.rs, client/src/declaration.rs).

title: Dialects
what: What markdown becomes in a provider's rooms: the dialect contract, its declaration and limits, its reading, splitting and folding of markdown, and the plain default that strips every mark (provider/src/dialect.rs, provider/src/plain.rs, client/src/dialect.rs).

title: Wire errors
what: The error shape every failure crosses in, with the code a caller matches on, the HTTP status each code answers, and the retry delay for a service that is not ready (provider/src/error.rs, client/src/error.rs).

title: Message file fetches
what: The request that fetches a message's pictures and files from the platform again, what the fetch came to, and the query that carries the message's sending time (provider/src/media.rs, client/src/media.rs).

title: Message hand-overs
what: A message as a provider hands it to the receiving side: its origin, sender, room facts, context and the files it carries, plus the patch that follows a gathering (provider/src/message.rs, client/src/message.rs).

title: Numbering
what: Whose numbers a provider's rooms, people and messages carry, the ranges it assigns them in, and the checks that refuse a bad numbering or two providers whose ranges overlap (provider/src/numbering.rs, client/src/numbering.rs).

title: Read modes
what: One way a provider's rooms are read: whose account speaks, what it receives and where the mode stands, with whether an answer can be pinned to a message it delivered (provider/src/modes.rs, client/src/modes.rs).

title: Receiving-side bodies
what: The bodies of the receiving-side routes: a room as the receiving side holds it, the queries a provider asks with, a message as held after a hand-over, and word of changed profile pictures (provider/src/receiver_bodies.rs, client/src/receiver_bodies.rs).

title: Refusals and missed pictures
what: The refusals a provider answers when it does not perform a send or a fetch, each with a fixed code and English sentence, and the album pictures that did not go with their reasons (provider/src/refusal.rs, client/src/missed.rs).

title: Route bodies
what: The small bodies the routes carry: a provider's health and its knowledge of a room, the owner's room, the dialect's reading and check, and the page every list answers in (provider/src/bodies.rs, client/src/bodies.rs).

title: Sends and their results
what: The twelve kinds of send, each with its own fields, the request around them, and what a send came to: the sent message and the album pictures that did not go (provider/src/send.rs, client/src/send.rs).
